# Side A 0.5.63
- A reply from your iPhone to a Claude session in Side A no longer stops at a draft in its prompt: the draft goes into Claude's stash and comes back once the reply is in, and a reply left typed but unsent goes in when you retry it. - A reply from your iPhone never replaces a draft you already stashed in Claude with Ctrl+S. - When Side A can't type a reply into your own terminal, your iPhone can continue the session in Side A and send it there. Without tmux, the reply says to install it.
macOS 14 or later. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free.
